component.name: Sign with LibreSCRS Smart Card
Потпиши LibreSCRS паметном картицом
Potpiši LibreSCRS pametnom karticom
component.summary: Share-menu action that digitally signs a file with a smart card
Радња из менија дељења која дигитално потписује датотеку паметном картицом
Radnja iz menija deljenja koja digitalno potpisuje datoteku pametnom karticom

description.p: A KDE Purpose plugin that adds a "Sign with LibreSCRS Smart Card" action to the file-manager Share menu. It hands the selected file to the LibreSCRS session agent, which performs the signature on the card and returns a signed artifact written next to the original. The signature format is chosen from the file type (PAdES for PDF, XAdES for XML, JAdES for JSON, ASiC-E for ASiC-E containers, CAdES otherwise). All card access, secret entry (PIN/CAN) and signing policy live in the agent; this plugin performs no cryptographic operations and holds no secrets of its own.
